$comment: CN-016 — what the smoke test opens after every deploy and every night (tools/smoke.mjs). storefront: every built storefront page, opened signed out like a customer; each PR that builds a storefront page adds it here (PR 72/73: the search results page, with and without words). The admin pages are found from the admin menu after sign-in. ignoreRequests: request paths whose failure is known and owned by a register PR, each with the PR that removes it; keep this list short. ~~/favicon.ico until PR 501~~: it always answers now (the owner's brand.favicon, else a neutral bag icon). discover (PR 49): pages found on a built page, opened like the listed ones: the first product pages New in links to (the products are the owner's, so none is named here; a shop with no product yet opens none). checks: extra checks after the pages, signed in, once — a page element's value (page, selector, attribute, equals) or a request's answer (request, status), each with the PR it guards; a request with `anonymous: true` goes out with no cookie and no preview login (like an outside system), and `field` names a key the app's own JSON answer must carry, so the preview gate's own 401 never passes for the app's (follow-up 80). A check with `host` runs only on that kind of host (R2 ops review M2, PR 402): `staging` = the preview host, `extra` = the main domain the first-week watch smokes; the preview's noindex check is `staging` only. figures (PR 155, CN-022): admin pages that show the one KPI pair, opened signed in on each screen; each selector must match exactly one element with a label and a figure (`value`, default b), and the labels must differ, so Sales (delivered orders only) and Ordered value stay separate figures. PR 12 (CN-022): the Dashboard (/admin?home=1) ~~shows the pair as two tiles, value `.a2-kv`~~; PR 12 (CN-025, CN-027): the V12.4 default, the delivered-sales story with the ordered value on its own line, value `.a3-num`. admin (PR 12): the signed-in admin pages opened after the menu's links, on every screen — every built admin page and every section placeholder, because the new sidebar links only each section's first page; /admin/delivery is the moved page's permanent redirect. A page check may `press` a key after loading (Control+K opens the command palette). Follow-up 200 (S05): the order list and the To confirm call queue, and (adminDiscover, signed in) the first order page the list links to (the orders are the owner's, so none is named here; a shop with no order yet opens none). PR 91–103: the sets landing page in both languages, PR 98, 100: the set builder in both languages (its "taking a break" page while the owner`s switch is off), and (discover) the first combo pages its cards open (the combos are the owner's, so none is named here). PR 572: a rule`s own page /combos/<rule key> is what a rule`s card opens now, so the same discover step opens it (the rules are the owner`s, so none is named here). PR 161: Orders › Risk rules (under the Orders tabs' More). PR 542: the advance pay link's page in both languages (/pay/0 is no link: its "not found" card, never an error screen). PR 286: (adminDiscover, signed in) the first customer page the Customers list links to (the customers are the owner`s, so none is named here; a shop with no customer yet opens none). R2 ops review (minor 5): Website › SEO › Redirects & 404 (the PR 587 go-live map, smoked before go-live), Website › SEO › Collection pages, Orders › Returns › Receive & QC and Products › New product; none is closed by a switch (the read-only check account sees the last two as their no-access state). Gate F-054: an adminDiscover entry may carry `query`, the found page opened at that tab (the same customer page at its Wallet tab). Live gate run 1 Nov (PR 414 follow-up): My account › Wallet in both languages, the page the go-live gate's link check could not reach once from Profile.

mayBeOff.$comment: PR 228 (qa-gate): pages an owner's switch closes with a 404 (the sitemaps: seo.sitemaps off, or a kind unticked in seo.indexing). They are opened from the storefront list as usual, but their own 404 is not a failure, so switching them off can never fail a deploy and roll it back; a 5xx or the error screen still fails.
